text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Bahrain Training Institute was asked by the Labour Ministry to train job seekers.
- Bahrain slams defiant Israel for building a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.
- Bahrain's Emir invited to attend an Islamic summit in Tehran. Iran's foreign minister paid a short visit to Bahrain on Wednesday to deliver the invitation.
- Bahrain's State Security Court tries a group of suspects in a plot to topple the government.
